title: AVA custom TUI theme
description: Editor-facing schema for files under $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/ava/themes/*.json. The AVA runtime loader remains authoritative.
$comment: This intentionally documents AVA's current minimal custom theme shape: name, optional vars, and eight ncurses color roles. It is not Pi's broader 51-token theme schema.

$schema.description: Optional editor schema URI; ignored by AVA.

name.description: Unique custom theme name. AVA rejects whitespace, path separators, '.', '..', built-in aliases, and reset aliases.

vars.description: Optional color variables referenced by string color values. AVA reports undefined variables and cycles at load time.

colors.description: AVA's current eight ncurses palette roles.

colorValue.description: Color value accepted by AVA: empty string for terminal default, 0-255 xterm color integer, 6-digit #RRGGBB string approximated to xterm-256, or a key from vars.
